coaches.name: Nagib Ward
coaches.bio: Took over as head coach ahead of the 2026–27 season. Originally from Évian-les-Bains, France, he grew up playing in France and Switzerland and came up through the Genève-Servette program. Played professionally for the Flammes Bleues de Reims, Brûleurs de Loups of Grenoble, and Pingouins de Morzine-Avoriaz. Holds an MSc in Biochemistry from Northern Michigan and an MBA from Marquette.

coaches.name: Eric Mura
coaches.bio: Assistant and defensive coach since 2020. Played defense for the IcePack from 2017 to 2019 and was named 2019 ACCHL Tournament MVP. Master of Architecture from NC State.

coaches.name: Dwight Collinson
coaches.bio: USA Hockey certified Level 5 coach. Coached with Raleigh Youth Hockey Association and Jr. Hurricanes since 2008. Experienced CFO with an MSc in Accounting from Walsh University.

coaches.name: Wade Tulk
coaches.bio: NCAA DII national champion at Alabama-Huntsville (24-0-3 record). Former pro player for the Nashville Nighthawks and Huntsville Channel Cats.

coaches.name: Alex Rossetto
coaches.bio: Goaltending coach since 2016. Directs the 919 Goaltending program developing collegiate and junior netminders.

board.name: Rick Daniel
board.bio: Took over as General Manager ahead of the 2026–27 season, bringing years of business leadership from CAHA and NC State Poole College of Management.

board.name: Brent Plunkett
board.bio: Played for the Icepack from 1998 to 2001. CEO of Charter Wealth Management, longtime donor, and member of the Advisory Board.

media_staff.name: Kaydee Gawlik
media_staff.bio: Director of Creative and Marketing since 2025. BA from NC State.
